messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated 502/503 rate detected for api-gateway on enterprise routes. Paging on-call.

jaya (oncall-sre): Im taking this incident. Seeing start at 15:02 UTC — spikes in eu-west and us-east. Paging @sam and @oscar to assist. Root thread here.

sam (eng-sre): looking. No prod deploys in the last 50m per deploy-bot. grabbing logs and recent kernel/sidecar traces.

oscar (prodops): autoscaler observed oscillation on gateway-frontend. Several pods in CrashLoopBackOff; memory/FD pressure flagged on nodes running cache-compaction jobs.

jaya (oncall-sre): short mitigation: bump gateway-frontend replicas +3, cordon a suspicious node and drain it. Doing now.

sam (eng-sre): also applying emergency client-side throttle to emergency-route prefixes to reduce noisy write traffic. Patch applied:
```
# emergency rate limiter
apiVersion: v1
kind: Config
routes:
  - "/v1/enterprise/*"
  - "/v1/payments/*"
limit: 80rps
window: 10s
```

jaya (oncall-sre): throttle active. 5xx rate dropped ~60% within 4 minutes. Leaving mitigation loop open — need customer-impact mapping for comms.

lucas (customer-success): pulling account-route mapping. Impacted enterprise customers (matched to affected endpoints):
- Stellar Payments 	acct: STELLAR-ENT-01 	Primary: irene@redwood.ai 	Phone: +1-415-555-0101
- Meridian Bank 	acct: MERIDIAN-UK-02 	Primary: finops@meridian.co.uk 	Phone: +44 20 5555 0202
- Kestrel Labs 	acct: KE-09 	Primary: ke-admin@kestrel.io 	Phone: +1-212-555-0303
- Aurora Logistics 	acct: AURORA-ENT-05 	Primary: ops@aurora-log.com 	Phone: +61 2 5555 0404

irene (account-manager): Stellar seeing degraded writes. Theyre asking for immediate note and want a 24h post-incident summary. Please mark them P1 for follow-up.

sam (eng-sre): quick tech summary so far: a background KV cache compaction job on a subset of nodes leaked file descriptors. Sidecars serving gateway hit FD exhaustion and caused 502/503 to callers. I have a fix branch that closes fds; will run rolling restart after canary validation. ETA full remediation ~ 25 minutes.

oscar (prodops): remediation steps (owner: oscar):
1) cordon affected nodes
2) restart gateway-frontend + sidecars, one node at a time (max 1 concurrent)
3) promote patch to canary (2 nodes) -> validate 5 minutes
4) full rollout
Risk: low-medium. Throttle reduces blast radius. I'll lead the rollout.

jaya (oncall-sre): drafting status-page update and customer notices. Please review text then Ill publish and hand to CS for send.

sam (eng-sre): canary applied to 2 nodes; no fd leaks after 10m monitoring. proceeding to restart node-1 of 6.

jaya (oncall-sre): STATUS PAGE DRAFT:
[Status] Partial service degradation 	API gateway
Time: 2026-06-01T15:05Z
Impact: Some enterprise API requests are returning 502/503 errors. Engineers have applied emergency throttling and are performing rolling restarts. Affected customers may see increased latency or transient errors on write endpoints.
Next update: in 15 minutes or as mitigation progresses.
Details: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1781521500

lucas (customer-success): CUSTOMER EMAIL TEMPLATE (tailored per account)  please review before sending:
--- EMAIL TEMPLATE START ---
Subject: Immediate notice: Partial disruption to Redwood API affecting write endpoints
Hi {Name},
Were investigating a partial service disruption that may cause intermittent 502/503 responses for some API write endpoints. Our engineers have applied emergency throttling and are performing rolling restarts to remediate the issue. We expect transient impact for up to ~30 minutes while we complete remediation.
What were doing: applying throttles, performing rolling restarts of gateway nodes, and deploying a fix for a cache compaction resource leak.
What you may observe: intermittent 502/503 responses, increased latency on some write paths.
Next update: within 15 minutes. A full incident summary will be delivered within 24 hours.
If you need immediate assistance or a bridge, reply to this email or contact {primary_contact_phone}.
Thanks,
Redwood Customer Success
--- EMAIL TEMPLATE END ---

irene (account-manager): For Stellar please append: "We are prioritizing your account for immediate follow-up and will schedule a 1:1 post-incident call if any data-consistency concerns are identified." Approved to send.

jaya (oncall-sre): INTERNAL COMM SNIPPET (ops/exec):
Partial gateway disruption affecting select enterprise routes. Emergency throttle applied; rolling restarts underway. 5xx rate down ~70% from peak. ETA full recovery: 20-35m. Owners: jaya (oncall-sre), oscar (prodops), sam (eng-sre). Will escalate to execs if customer impact widens.

tara (security): any sensitive data exposure in logs? No indications. Keep security on the loop for postmortem.

oscar (prodops): node restarts: node-1..node-3 complete, node-4 running. Telemetry post-restart looks stable; no new CrashLoopBackOffs.

sam (eng-sre): merged fix to main. canary stable for 12 minutes. preparing full rollout across remaining nodes.

incident-bot: Status updated: investigating -> identifying root cause -> mitigating (https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1781521500)

jaya (oncall-sre): 5xx back to baseline. Throttle will remain for 10 more minutes, then removed. Preparing handoff notes for next oncall.

jaya (oncall-sre): ONCALL HANDOFF NOTE:
- Current: mitigation complete; rolling restarts finished; throttle scheduled for removal in 10m.
- Next steps: monitor metrics for 30m, confirm no fd leak re-occurrence.
- If regression: page @sam and @oscar immediately.
- Postmortem lead: jaya; timeline + customer comms to be published within 24h.

lucas (customer-success): customer notifications sent to the four impacted accounts. Stellar replied asking for replay timeline; scheduling a callback.

jaya (oncall-sre): will close the incident thread in 30m after stability window. Postmortem link to be attached once ready. Great work everyone. :thumbsup:
